exceptions.reason: No rated easy source, observed easy template, or validated easy sampling policy at source basis 1935. Bounded evidence limitation; new source evidence reopens classification.
Unrated source has no correct-answer reference and no worked solution. Not eligible for difficulty-weighted stock; not silently assigned a level.
Two distractors ln(K|x|/2) and ln(2K|x|) differ by ln(4), an arbitrary integration constant. Duplicate antiderivative families violate distinct bank validation.
Distractors containing ln(|K|x) are undefined over real x<0. The source prompt allows either branch x!=0. This profile is excluded rather than silently corrected or restricting its domain.

sampling_policy: Positive rational source denominator 2 or 3; coprime numerator greater than denominator through 31. Negative rational uses denominator 2 and odd numerator 3..31. Linear template n=2..16. Square template (1+n/(2x))^2 uses odd n=3..31; a=1 excluded because this bank collides. These bounds cover every supported original and preserve workload. No mixing profiles.
task_identity: Simplified exact integrand; no seed, bank or option order. Owned record identities additionally distinguish exact authored banks.
